gameInfo.title: WordQuest Adventure
gameInfo.description: An educational word puzzle game that builds vocabulary, spelling, logical thinking, and pattern recognition.

levels.hint: You read this to learn new things

wordInfo.meaning: A written or printed work of pages.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: I love to read a good book before bed.
wordInfo.funFact: The longest book ever written is over 4 million words!

levels.hint: It twinkles in the night sky

wordInfo.meaning: A luminous point of light in the night sky.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: We wished upon a bright star last night.
wordInfo.funFact: The sun is actually a star!

levels.hint: Something fun you play with friends

wordInfo.meaning: An activity for entertainment or competition.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: Let's play a game after school!
wordInfo.funFact: The oldest known game is over 5,000 years old!

levels.hint: It has leaves and gives us shade

wordInfo.meaning: A tall plant with a trunk, branches, and leaves.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: The old tree in our yard is over 100 years old.
wordInfo.funFact: Some trees can live for thousands of years!

levels.hint: A white drink from cows

wordInfo.meaning: A white liquid produced by mammals for feeding young.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: I like to drink milk with my breakfast.
wordInfo.funFact: Humans are the only animals that drink milk from other animals!

levels.hint: You have five of these on your arms

wordInfo.meaning: The end part of the arm with fingers.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: Please wash your hands before eating.
wordInfo.funFact: Your fingerprints are completely unique to you!

levels.hint: It swims in water

wordInfo.meaning: An animal that lives in water and has gills.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: We saw a colorful fish at the aquarium.
wordInfo.funFact: There are over 30,000 different species of fish!

levels.hint: It has feathers and can fly

wordInfo.meaning: A warm-blooded animal with feathers and wings.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: A little bird sat on my windowsill this morning.
wordInfo.funFact: Hummingbirds can fly backwards!

levels.hint: It shines in the night sky

wordInfo.meaning: The natural satellite that orbits Earth.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: The moon looks beautiful tonight.
wordInfo.funFact: The moon is about 238,900 miles from Earth!

levels.hint: Water that falls from clouds

wordInfo.meaning: Water falling from clouds in drops.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: We need rain to help the plants grow.
wordInfo.funFact: A single raindrop falls at about 14 mph!

levels.hint: It gives us light and warmth

wordInfo.meaning: The star at the center of our solar system.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: The sun rose over the mountains this morning.
wordInfo.funFact: The sun is actually a medium-sized star!

levels.hint: A small furry pet that says meow

wordInfo.meaning: A small domesticated carnivorous mammal.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: My cat loves to play with yarn.
wordInfo.funFact: Cats spend 70% of their lives sleeping!

levels.hint: A loyal pet that barks

wordInfo.meaning: A domesticated carnivorous mammal kept as a pet.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: The dog wagged its tail happily.
wordInfo.funFact: Dogs can learn over 1,000 words!

levels.hint: The color of fire trucks

wordInfo.meaning: A color at the end of the spectrum like blood.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: She wore a beautiful red dress.
wordInfo.funFact: Red is the most visible color from a distance!

levels.hint: The color of the ocean

wordInfo.meaning: A color like the sky on a clear day.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: The sky is beautiful and blue today.
wordInfo.funFact: Blue is the world's most popular favorite color!

levels.hint: You kick or throw this to play

wordInfo.meaning: A round object used in games and sports.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: The kids played with a ball at recess.
wordInfo.funFact: The oldest known ball is over 3,500 years old!

levels.hint: A sweet dessert for birthdays

wordInfo.meaning: A sweet baked food made with flour and sugar.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: Mom made a chocolate cake for my birthday.
wordInfo.funFact: The world's largest cake weighed over 81 tons!

levels.hint: Where you live with your family

wordInfo.meaning: A house or place where one lives.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: I love coming home after school.
wordInfo.funFact: The word 'home' comes from an old English word meaning 'village'!

levels.hint: A strong feeling of caring

wordInfo.meaning: A deep feeling of affection.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: I have so much love for my family.
wordInfo.funFact: The heart symbol ❤️ has been used for over 500 years!

levels.hint: What you do for fun after homework

wordInfo.meaning: To engage in activity for enjoyment.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: Let's go outside and play!
wordInfo.funFact: Play is so important that it's a right of every child!

levels.hint: It grows in soil and needs sunlight

wordInfo.meaning: A living thing that grows in the ground.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: I water my plant every morning.
wordInfo.funFact: Some plants can communicate with each other!

levels.hint: Sandy place next to the ocean

wordInfo.meaning: A sandy or pebbly shore by the ocean.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: We built sandcastles at the beach.
wordInfo.funFact: The longest beach in the world is 150 miles long!

levels.hint: Sound that people make with instruments

wordInfo.meaning: The art of organizing sound in time.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: I love listening to music while I study.
wordInfo.funFact: Playing music uses almost every part of your brain!

levels.hint: A round red or green fruit

wordInfo.meaning: A round fruit with red or green skin.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: An apple a day keeps the doctor away!
wordInfo.funFact: There are over 7,500 varieties of apples!

levels.hint: You eat dinner on this

wordInfo.meaning: A piece of furniture with a flat top.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: We set the table for dinner.
wordInfo.funFact: The first tables were used in ancient Egypt!

levels.hint: It floats in the sky and brings rain

wordInfo.meaning: A visible mass of water droplets in the sky.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: Look at that big fluffy cloud!
wordInfo.funFact: A single cloud can weigh over a million pounds!

levels.hint: You drink this every day

wordInfo.meaning: A clear liquid essential for life.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: Please get me a glass of water.
wordInfo.funFact: Water covers about 71% of Earth's surface!

levels.hint: What comes from the sun or a lamp

wordInfo.meaning: The natural agent that makes things visible.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: Turn on the light so I can read.
wordInfo.funFact: Light travels at 186,000 miles per second!

levels.hint: A feeling of joy and contentment

wordInfo.meaning: Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: I'm so happy to see you!
wordInfo.funFact: Being happy can actually make you healthier!

levels.hint: A very large body of salt water

wordInfo.meaning: A very large expanse of salt water.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: The ocean is home to millions of species.
wordInfo.funFact: The ocean is so deep that 95% of it is unexplored!

levels.hint: The color of grass and leaves

wordInfo.meaning: The color between blue and yellow.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: The grass looks so green after the rain.
wordInfo.funFact: Green is the easiest color for the human eye to see!

levels.hint: You sit on this

wordInfo.meaning: A separate seat for one person.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: Please have a seat in this chair.
wordInfo.funFact: The oldest known chair is over 5,000 years old!

levels.hint: What you do at night in bed

wordInfo.meaning: To rest in a state of natural unconsciousness.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: I need to sleep at least 8 hours every night.
wordInfo.funFact: Humans spend about one-third of their lives sleeping!

levels.hint: It shows you are happy

wordInfo.meaning: To form one's features into a pleased expression.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: Your smile makes everyone happy.
wordInfo.funFact: Smiling can actually reduce stress!

levels.hint: This organ helps you think

wordInfo.meaning: The organ inside the head that controls the body.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: Your brain is the most powerful computer!
wordInfo.funFact: The human brain has about 86 billion neurons!

levels.hint: The planet we live on

wordInfo.meaning: The planet on which we live.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: We should take care of our Earth.
wordInfo.funFact: Earth is the only planet not named after a god!

levels.hint: Images you see when sleeping

wordInfo.meaning: A series of images during sleep.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: I had a wonderful dream last night.
wordInfo.funFact: You forget about 95% of your dreams!

levels.hint: A large musical instrument with keys

wordInfo.meaning: A large musical instrument with black and white keys.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: She plays the piano beautifully.
wordInfo.funFact: A piano has 88 keys!

levels.hint: A fun stretchy toy kids play with

wordInfo.meaning: A thick, slippery substance.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: The kids loved playing with green slime!
wordInfo.funFact: Slime has been popular since the 1970s!

levels.hint: Our whole planet

wordInfo.meaning: The earth, together with all its countries and peoples.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: The world is a beautiful place.
wordInfo.funFact: There are 195 countries in the world!

levels.hint: What makes things red, blue, or yellow

wordInfo.meaning: The property of objects that produces different sensations.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: What color do you like best?
wordInfo.funFact: The human eye can see about 10 million colors!

levels.hint: Ice crystals on a cold morning

wordInfo.meaning: Thin ice crystals on a cold surface.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: The grass was covered in frost this morning.
wordInfo.funFact: Frost can form even when the temperature is above freezing!

levels.hint: A food made from flour and baked

wordInfo.meaning: A food made from flour, water, and yeast.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: I like to eat fresh bread for breakfast.
wordInfo.funFact: Bread has been made for over 14,000 years!

levels.hint: A small piece of rock

wordInfo.meaning: A small piece of rock found on the ground.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: I found a smooth stone on the beach.
wordInfo.funFact: Some stones are older than the dinosaurs!

levels.hint: A small round fruit that grows in bunches

wordInfo.meaning: A round fruit that grows in clusters on vines.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: These grapes are so sweet and juicy!
wordInfo.funFact: Grapes are grown on every continent except Antarctica!

levels.hint: The bright part of fire

wordInfo.meaning: A hot bright stream of burning gas.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: The candle flame flickered in the wind.
wordInfo.funFact: The hottest part of a flame is the blue part!

levels.hint: You wear this on your hand in winter

wordInfo.meaning: A covering for the hand with separate fingers.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: I wear gloves when it's cold outside.
wordInfo.funFact: Gloves have been worn for over 3,000 years!

levels.hint: When it's dark outside

wordInfo.meaning: The time of darkness between sunset and sunrise.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: The stars shine bright at night.
wordInfo.funFact: Nocturnal animals are most active at night!

levels.hint: Moving your body to music

wordInfo.meaning: To move rhythmically to music.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: I love to dance with my friends!
wordInfo.funFact: Dancing can improve your memory!

levels.hint: When the sky is bright with sunshine

wordInfo.meaning: Bright with or giving out sunlight.
wordInfo.exampleSentence: It's a beautiful sunny day!
wordInfo.funFact: The sun is actually white, but appears yellow from Earth!
